title: 1988 Fleer All Star #11 Jack Clark St. Louis Cardinals Baseball
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This is a 1988 Fleer All Star Team sports trading card featuring Jack Clark, a former baseball player for the St. Louis Cardinals. The card number is #11 and it is an original, not a reprint. The card was manufactured by Fleer in Chad and is part of the 1988 season. 

This trading card is a great addition to any sports memorabilia collection, especially for fans of the St. Louis Cardinals or Jack Clark. It is a must-have for any serious collector and is sure to be a conversation starter. Don't miss out on the opportunity to own this piece of sports history.
